name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka has been a fixture in the motorsport catering scene for over a decade. Starting as a kitchen assistant, he quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a keen understanding of logistical challenges and a talent for crafting menus that satisfy both drivers' nutritional needs and VIP guests' discerning palates. His foray into motorsport was accidental, helping a friend at a local karting event, but the energy and precision captivated him instantly. 

At MP Motorsport, Kenji is known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor, even under immense pressure. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he focuses on providing balanced, delicious meals that keep everyone performing at their best. What sets Kenji apart is his creative approach to food, often incorporating traditional Japanese flavors with modern culinary techniques, creating a unique and memorable dining experience for everyone involved.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a slightly athletic build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas and ingredient combinations.
Starts every day with a cup of matcha, regardless of location.
